fns.desc: wpas_rrm_send_neighbor_rep_request stores cb unconditionally into wpa_s->rrm.notify_neighbor_rep with no NULL check, contradicting its own doc comment 'Request must contain a callback function'; a caller passing cb=NULL would silently disable future neighbor-report delivery rather than being rejected up front.

WLAN_BEACON_REQUEST_SUBELEM_SSID case copies subelem into data->ssid sized by data->ssid_len=slen after only checking slen>SSID_MAX_LEN; relies on data->ssid being declared at least SSID_MAX_LEN bytes elsewhere (not verified in this file) with no local defensive bound restated at the memcpy site itself.

wpas_add_beacon_rep_elem's os_malloc(sizeof(*rep)+14+*ie_len+subelems_len) size is attacker-influenced via *ie_len (derived from over-the-air beacon IE data); no upper bound/sanity cap on *ie_len before the allocation, relying entirely on downstream wpas_beacon_rep_add_frame_body's rem_len bookkeeping to stay in-bounds rather than validating the size up front.
